verdict.rationale: Render's docs list a dedicated "Docker support" section, and an independent Hacker News user praises Render's "great docker support" compared with Heroku. Together these establish that Docker-packaged apps can be deployed, but the first-party evidence is only a section title. Missing for 10: detail on building from a Dockerfile vs. deploying prebuilt registry images, private registry authentication, and in-depth first-party documentation content.
